recognize_zh: 這是 IGV 基因體檢視畫面，位置在第 3 號染色體 MYD88 基因（chr3:38,182,641 附近）；灰色讀序中同一欄位有一部分顯示 C（T>C），對應下方胺基酸 L（白胺酸），代表 MYD88 L265P 突變，是淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤的分子標記。
features: Integrative Genomics Viewer screenshot of aligned NGS reads, chr3:38,182,621-38,182,661 (41 bp window)
MYD88 gene track with reference sequence and amino-acid translation at bottom
Single-position variant: blue 'C' base calls in a subset of reads at the same coordinate (T>C)
Altered codon corresponds to leucine (L) at the site of L265P (p.Leu265Pro; legacy numbering)
Isolated scattered mismatches in other reads (e.g., single T or G) represent sequencing noise
describe_en: Next-generation sequencing of bone marrow aspirate DNA, visualized in the Integrative Genomics Viewer, shows aligned reads across a 41-bp window of MYD88 on chromosome 3p22. A consistent T>C substitution is present in a subset of reads at a single coordinate (reported variant allele frequency approximately 30%), altering the leucine codon to proline and corresponding to MYD88 L265P. Isolated single-read mismatches elsewhere represent background sequencing noise. MYD88 L265P is present in more than 90% of lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma/Waldenström macroglobulinemia and supports that diagnosis in the appropriate morphologic and immunophenotypic context, although it is not entirely specific.

ddx.vs: MYD88 L265P occurs in only a minority (<10%) of MZL, so a positive result favors LPL but does not exclude MZL.
IgM MGUS also frequently harbors MYD88 L265P, so marrow infiltrate burden and paraprotein level are needed to separate it from LPL.

ddx.dx: Activated B-cell type DLBCL (e.g., primary CNS, testicular)
ddx.vs: ABC-DLBCL can carry MYD88 L265P but is morphologically a large-cell lymphoma, often with CD79B mutations.
